evidence.q1: One matrix titled 'Comparison against the tender requirement': a criterion column on the left and Halloway / Pentlow / Marrick as three columns of the same grid, each row scored across all three.
evidence.q2: All four named criteria are rows of that one matrix, grouped as PRICE AND CONTRACT VALUE ('Price per axle, fitted'), SUPPLY ('Lead time, planned replacement'), WARRANTY ('Casing warranty') and ON-SITE FITTING ('Fitting included in the price'), each showing three values.
evidence.q3: The pick is a radio in each supplier column header plus an 'Award' rail beside the top of the matrix carrying the selected supplier and the 'Award to Halloway Tyre Group' button; it sits level with the start of the comparison, not after it.
evidence.q4: Above the matrix sit a hero-scale title with a lede paragraph, an eight-field metadata strip, and a summary band 'The headline rate is not the contract cost' that states the ranking conclusion before any comparison.
evidence.q5: The masthead metadata is a stat row: OPERATOR, DEPOT, FLEET, SPECIFICATION, QUOTES RETURNED, EVALUATION CLOSES as label-over-value cells across one line; the closing 'Terms, exclusions and references' is a three-panel supplier grid.

evidence.q1: Ashcombe, Brayford and Ridgeway are the three columns of a single comparison table; every criterion is one row read straight across them.
evidence.q2: The table's own section rules are PRICE PER AXLE, LEAD TIME, WARRANTY and ON-SITE FITTING, each with several rows filled for all three columns inside the same table.
evidence.q3: A 'Select for award' radio sits in each of the three column headers at the top of the table, with an AWARD DRAFT rail alongside showing the current selection state; nothing about picking is below the table.
evidence.q4: Above the table there is a dark masthead with a tender stat strip, then a hero title and lede, a metadata grid, and an 'Engineering recommendation' callout that announces the winner before the comparison begins.
evidence.q5: Two stat rows exist: TENDER / RESPONSES / AWARD BY in the masthead, and SCOPE / VOLUME / FLEET / SIZES / DEPOTS / PREPARED beneath the lede; the footer is a three-column block grid.

evidence.q1: The 'Criterion by criterion' table holds Penmark, Draymoor and Halgarth as three columns against fourteen criterion rows in one region.
evidence.q2: Price per axle, Lead time, Warranty and On-site fitting are the first four rows of that table, each with a value in all three supplier columns and a ruled best value.
evidence.q3: A fixed bar spans the bottom of the viewport reading 'No supplier selected. Choose a column in the comparison to record an award.' with a 'Record an award' button; in the full-page capture it overlays mid-page content, confirming it is pinned rather than placed.
evidence.q4: A hero panel ('Award the 2027 tyre supply contract' plus lede and metadata grid) and a summary panel 'All three quotes on one basis', which restates every quote as one bar and one number, both precede the criterion table.
evidence.q5: The header metadata is a stat row of SPECIFICATION, FLEET, BASIS MILEAGE, QUOTES RETURNED, PREPARED BY, COUNTERSIGNED BY; 'What each choice costs you' at the foot is a three-column card grid, one per supplier.

evidence.q1: Section 01, 'The four criteria, side by side', is a single table with a Criterion column and Marchwood, Ardenmoor and Verrall as its three quote columns.
evidence.q2: The table runs the price rows (steer axle set, drive axle set, blended average, annual spend) then banded LEAD TIME, WARRANTY and ON-SITE FITTING sections, all three columns filled throughout.
evidence.q3: No pinned control: the three 'Award to ...' buttons are the last row of the very long table, and the committing action, 'Record award', is further down again in section 03 'Decision record', so the pick scrolls away and is reached only after the whole comparison.
evidence.q4: The first viewport is entirely pre-comparison: masthead with an 'AWARD OUTSTANDING' pill, a hero title and lede, a five-field strip, and a large RECOMMENDATION panel naming Marchwood with a landed-cost ranking.
evidence.q5: VEHICLES IN SCOPE / ANNUAL REQUIREMENT / SPECIFICATION / CONTRACT TERM / PREPARED BY form a ruled stat row under the lede; section 02 is a two-card panel pair and the footer is a four-column block grid.
